title: SEASON ZERO M1: NO CASH IN RAIDS
why: his rulings of 11-01 (m1): no cash in raids, keep it like a credit card; money comes from selling gear and a bonus; contracts pay in gear and items to sell; racks pay materials instead of money; his pick 36, an extraction bonus of about 10 percent of the haul
now: an extraction pays a bonus of 10 percent of the secured haul onto the account and into lifetime earnings, shown as extraction bonus on the card; a death or a walk out pays none; the stall banks a sale at once so a death keeps it; the survivor and the raid goals pay salvage of the same value instead of money; a contract pays salvage worth its old reward plus its gear, and a gun you own comes as a spare to the stash; racks and arrays pay rack parts worth what they paid; hire cuts count in lifetime earnings
